title: Spring Boot, Visualized
tagline: IoC, beans, REST, JPA, transactions, security and testing, as pictures.
description: A visual study book for Spring and Spring Boot: IoC and dependency injection, the bean lifecycle, the request flow, REST APIs, auto-configuration, JPA and Spring Data, validation, exceptions, transactions, security with JWT, Actuator, caching, async, testing, microservices and Spring Boot 4.
